messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for control-plane proxied requests. service=cp-gateway metric=5xx_rate value=8% (baseline ~2%). Possible dependencies: auth, org-lookup, billing. Paging @lucy - oncall @kevin

lucy - oncall: ack - I'm on it. starting with gateway traces and recent deploys. kevin, any prod deploys or config flips in last 30m?

kevin: no prod deploys from us in last 30m. spike starts ~15:02 UTC. correlating traces show timeouts to org-lookup and slow token verify to auth. snippet:```\n[15:02:13] upstream=org-lookup timeout_ms=600 status=504
[15:02:13] upstream=auth token_verify_ms=520 status=502
[15:02:14] upstream=billing latency_ms=420 status=502
```\n
maya: also seeing auth CPU on two nodes at ~95%, and billing client retries increasing. gateway shows retry amplification - a few clients retry aggressively.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook matched: controlplane-cascade. Recommended immediate mitigations: 1) isolate dependency with circuit at proxy 2) throttle/reduce retry window 3) scale auth pool 4) customer comms. Link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/controlplane-cascade

lucy - oncall: enabling circuit-breaker for org-lookup at the gateway level to short-circuit failing dependency. running:```\nkubectl patch deployment cp-gateway -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"cp/disable-orglookup":"true"}}}}}'\n```watching metrics.

kevin: good call. also setting a header to limit retries from the gateway side to avoid amplification: add X-Retry-Limit:1 for proxied requests. pushing a config toggle to the gateway configmap.

support-ops: customer-impact update: first spike observed 15:02 UTC. ~12% of /v1/infer requests returned 5xx (EU + NA). escalating to SEV2. CS has been notified and is prepping a message template.

maya: after circuit enabled (~15:06), global 5xx dropped to ~2.1%. auth latency still high on 1 host - investigating pod cp-auth-7. logs show repeated "store write timeout" calls.

ops-eng: initiated pod eviction for cp-auth-7 to force restart and reschedule:```\nkubectl drain cp-auth-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n prod\n```pod restarted on different node. logs during restart show cache-miss storm. not seeing OOM.

patrick: looks like a cache stampede after the restart. recommending targeted prefix purge on KV cache to avoid thundering herd:```\ncurl -X POST https://cache.prod/internal/purge -d '{"prefix":"orglookup:"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>'\n```(internal-only endpoint)

lucy - oncall: after cache purge + pod restart, auth latency trended down and 5xx rate normalized to ~0.6% by 15:22. leaving circuit-breaker enabled for 30m for stability.

incident-bot: NOTE: last config change affecting cp-gateway: config_id=cfg-20260315-2 (feature toggles). flagged as rollback candidate if we see recurrence.

kevin: will prepare rollback plan for cfg-20260315-2 but holding for now since mitigations are effective. also creating an alert: auth_cpu > 80% for 5m -> paging.

support-ops: CS interim message drafted: "We observed elevated errors impacting inference calls this afternoon. Mitigation is in place (temporary org-lookup circuit and targeted pod restart). No data loss. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with postmortem."

maya: assigning postmortem leads: rc-lead=maya, mitigations-lead=kevin, comms=support-ops, timeline-owner=lucy - oncall. scheduling postmortem meeting for tomorrow.

lucy - oncall: preparing handoff to @kevin for the 16:00 UTC oncall window. kevin, you're primary for next 2 hours.

kevin: ack handoff. I'll monitor and will revert config toggle if we see regression. pushed short-term perf alert and increased auth pool replicas by 2 as preemptive scale.

sre-runbook-bot: Incident transitioned out of active mitigation at 15:28 UTC. Please capture timeline and alerts for postmortem.

support-ops: final note - severity will remain SEV2 until postmortem completed. CS will notify any affected customers with the interim message within 30m.

lucy - oncall: closing active chat for now. thanks everyone for quick coord. will post timeline + artifacts (traces, graphs, logs) to the incident doc.

kevin: adding follow-up TODOs in the incident doc: - validate cache resilience on auth restarts - add exponential backoff + jitter on org-lookup client - evaluate config toggle rollback window - improve retry headers at gateway

patrick: also adding: investigate persistent store write timeouts for cp-auth - maybe warrants deeper I/O profiling.

incident-bot: incident thread archived."
